Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to express my sincere thanks for [việc được giúp — V-ing]. I greatly appreciate the time and effort you devoted to this. Your assistance made a real difference to the preparations for [sự kiện / hoạt động].

paragraphs.label: Tác dụng
paragraphs.text: Thanks to your support, I was able to explore a short local route and note useful improvements without rushing through the instructions.
